claims.label: Host Says Nielsen Super Bowl Viewership Increased During Halftime
claims.claim: The host says Nielsen estimates 128 million viewers watched the Super Bowl game, increasing to 135 million during the halftime performance.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary Nielsen release or interim report to confirm the 128M / 135M figures.

claims.label: Kolvet Initial Six Million Concurrent YouTube Claim
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Kolvet claimed the TPUSA halftime show drew 6 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Kolvet's interview statement against any contemporaneous social media archives or third-party tracking data.

claims.label: Kolvet Ten Million Concurrent Across Social Claim
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated TPUSA saw "over 10 million concurrent views" across all social channels (Rumble plus partners).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify whether the 10M figure is supported by any third-party analytics for Rumble or YouTube.

claims.label: Kolvet Twenty Million Total Across Social Claim
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated TPUSA had "over 20 million viewers across just social" for the halftime show.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 20M aggregate figure against partner broadcaster analytics if/when released.

claims.label: TPUSA Halftime YouTube Screenshot Metrics
claims.claim: The host shows a YouTube screenshot of the TPUSA halftime show page that she says displayed 5,839 views, 175 comments, and 667,000 likes.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the YouTube page and timestamp the screenshot for ratio analysis.

claims.label: India Moon Mission Top YouTube Live Stream
claims.claim: Per the displayed reference list, an Indian moon mission event held the top YouTube concurrent live stream at 8 million viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 8M figure against YouTube's official records or contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: 2022 World Cup Second on YouTube Live Streams List
claims.claim: Per the displayed reference list, the 2022 World Cup Brazil vs Croatia match held the second-place position with 6.1 million concurrent YouTube viewers.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 6.1M figure against YouTube's official records or contemporaneous reporting.

claims.label: Erika Kirk Widow Address View Counts
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk's widow address video on Charlie Kirk's YouTube channel has approximately 4.1 million views and 36,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current YouTube view and comment counts on the Charlie Kirk channel.

claims.label: Candace "Letter to Erika" View Counts
claims.claim: Candace Owens' "Letter to Erika" YouTube video has approximately 3.1 million views and 28,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify current YouTube view and comment counts on Candace Owens' channel.

claims.label: TPUSA Halftime Show View-to-Comment Ratio
claims.claim: The host says the TPUSA halftime show YouTube page has over 20 million views but only 46,000 comments.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-check current YouTube view and comment counts; compute ratio comparison against authentic videos of similar scale.

claims.label: Thomas Martin LinkedIn Profile
claims.claim: Per a LinkedIn link the host shows, Thomas Martin is listed as Director, US Border Patrol, with location in the Greater Tucson area.
claims.investigative_direction: Attempt to retrieve LinkedIn snapshot via archive; cross-check against federal personnel directories.

claims.label: Thomas Martin ZoomInfo DHS Profile
claims.claim: Per a ZoomInfo listing the host shows, Thomas Martin is Deputy Chief Patrol Agent at the Department of Homeland Security, with 9 years in Customs and Border Protection.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve ZoomInfo archive; cross-check federal personnel records.

claims.label: Thomas Martin as 1985 Border Patrol Agent
claims.claim: A 1985 Times Union article identifies agent Thomas Martin of the Border Patrol in Tucson in the context of the sanctuary movement trial.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text of the 1985 Times Union article and verify Thomas Martin's role and tenure.

claims.label: Thomas Martin 1985 Memo on Church Invasions
claims.claim: The host says that, in the 1985 article, Thomas Martin is quoted writing to superiors that a ploy would be 'border patrol baiting' to show the public the US government thinks nothing of breaking down church doors, which she reads as his argument against invading the churches.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full text and verify direct quote attribution.

claims.label: Tracy's Daughter Scheduled at UVU September 10
claims.claim: The host says that, per text messages from September 11 she says she has, Tracy Martin told friends her daughter, possibly Erika Kirk's assistant, was supposed to be at UVU on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text messages; verify daughter's attendance plans through UVU records or eyewitnesses.

claims.label: Host Says Tracy's Bad Feeling Stopped Daughter from UVU
claims.claim: Per text messages from September 11th that the host says she has, Tracy Martin told friends she had a "bad feeling" about September 10 and stopped her daughter from attending UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate text messages; cross-reference with daughter's subsequent statements or activities.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Religious Liberty Commission Testimony
claims.claim: Seth Dillon testified at a Religious Liberty Commission hearing on antisemitism.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain official hearing transcript or recording.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Hamptons "Save the West" Characterization
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Seth Dillon says the Hamptons retreat had a 'save the West' theme and that Charlie Kirk's primary focus was 'the threat of Islam.'
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with prior Hamptons participants' public statements and any contemporaneous notes.

claims.label: Host Says Seth Dillon Is Adjusting His Story on Hamptons Debate
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, Seth Dillon says the Hamptons meeting included 'heated and spirited debate about the issue of Israel,' and the host says he lied and is now adjusting his story.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare admission against earlier public statements by Hamptons participants and Charlie Kirk's own descriptions.

claims.label: Seth Dillon Charlie-Originated Debate Claim
claims.claim: Seth Dillon claimed Charlie Kirk himself initiated the Israel discussion at the Hamptons meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference with Charlie Kirk's own public statements about the Hamptons meeting.

claims.label: Host Says Carrie Prejean Boller Questioned Seth Dillon
claims.claim: The host says Carrie Prejean Boller questioned Seth Dillon at the Religious Liberty Commission hearing regarding antisemitism and the Hamptons meeting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full hearing transcript.

claims.label: Tyler Bowyer TPUSA Concurrent Stream Tweet
claims.claim: Tyler Bowyer tweeted that TPUSA ended up with "one of the largest YouTube concurrent live streams in history."
claims.investigative_direction: Archive the original tweet and any associated image; verify whether it remains public.

claims.label: AO Comment on Erika Lights Flickering Confirmation
claims.claim: A viewer comment the host reads says there is a clip of Erika speaking to Megyn Kelly that confirms the host's recollection of lights flickering.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the referenced clip of Erika Kirk speaking to Megyn Kelly.

claims.label: GN2176 Book Comparison Comment
claims.claim: Commenter GN2176 states that the Charlie Kirk story resembles "a book being written about Charlie Kirk's trial leading up to a September 10th execution like St. Thomas More."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify any actual book project matching this description.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk Parents Have Not Reached Out to Candace
claims.claim: Per host statement read aloud from comment thread context, Charlie Kirk's parents have not reached out to Candace Owens to validate her investigation, though they have historically been private.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through any other public statements from Charlie Kirk's parents or family representatives.

claims.label: Host Says Jay-Z Controls Halftime Booking and Booked Bad Bunny
claims.claim: The host says that Jay-Z, in partnership with the NFL, controls who performs at the Super Bowl halftime and that he booked Bad Bunny.
claims.investigative_direction: NFL or Roc Nation announcements and reporting on who selected the 2026 halftime performer.
claims.transcript_snippet: Actually, I looked into it. The person that controls who gets to perform at the halftime is Jay-Z. For some reason, Jay-Z in partnership with the NFL, Jay-Z doesn't speak Spanish, but Jay-Z booked him.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Announced an Alternative Halftime Show and Trump Tweeted
claims.claim: The host says that after Bad Bunny's booking drew backlash, Turning Point USA announced an alternative all-American halftime show and President Trump tweeted about it.
claims.investigative_direction: TPUSA announcement of the alternative show and the Trump post, with dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA announced that they would produce an alternative quote unquote all-American Super Bowl halftime show. and President Trump tweeted.

claims.label: Host Says Bad Bunny Did Not Wear a Dress at the Super Bowl
claims.claim: The host says Bad Bunny did not in fact wear a dress during the Super Bowl halftime performance, although the prospect had driven the backlash.
claims.investigative_direction: Broadcast footage of the halftime performance.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, Bad Bunny did not in fact wear a dress at the Super Bowl. He didn't, which like I said, I'm very against that.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA's Counter-Programming Failed to Draw Viewers From the NFL
claims.claim: The host says the viewership figures mean the political lines drawn by Turning Point USA did not succeed in drawing people away from the NFL's viewership.
claims.investigative_direction: Nielsen's final halftime and game figures compared with TPUSA's claimed audience.
claims.transcript_snippet: This means uh that the I would say unnecessary Super Bowl political lines that were drawn by Turning Point USA was not successful in terms of drawing people away from the NFL's viewership.

claims.label: Host Says the TPUSA Show Was Pre-Recorded a Couple of Weeks Earlier
claims.claim: The host says the Turning Point USA halftime show was pre-recorded, she thinks a couple of weeks earlier, while Bad Bunny performed live, giving TPUSA time to edit and present it.
claims.investigative_direction: TPUSA production schedule and the show's recording date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, we should be clear, it was a pre-record, okay? So, Bad Bunny was performing live. Turning point USA pre-recorded, I think a couple of weeks ago.

claims.label: Host Names Kid Rock and Lee Brice as TPUSA Show Performers
claims.claim: The host names Kid Rock and Lee Brice as artists who performed in the Turning Point USA halftime show and says there were a couple of other artists.
claims.investigative_direction: Official TPUSA show lineup.
claims.transcript_snippet: I'm going to park aside the artists who actually performed. Uh, Kid Rock, Lee Brice.

claims.label: Host Says Her Own Stream Had 95,000 Concurrent Viewers as a Benchmark
claims.claim: The host says her stream had about 95,000 concurrent viewers while on air and argues that YouTube would show roughly 200,000 to 300,000 views immediately after it ends, as a benchmark against TPUSA's claimed six million concurrent.
claims.investigative_direction: The episode's own concurrent and final view counts after the stream ended, compared with the TPUSA page.
claims.transcript_snippet: We have 95,000 people that are watching this show. As soon as this show concludes, I want you to see how many views uh YouTube is going to instantly give it right away.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Wants Viewers to Believe It Is Second on YouTube's Concurrent List
claims.claim: The host says that, taking Kolvet's six million concurrent figure at face value, Turning Point wants viewers to believe its show ranks second on YouTube's all-time concurrent list, behind only India's moon mission.
claims.investigative_direction: YouTube's all-time peak concurrent viewership rankings and any TPUSA entry.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point wants you to believe that they're number two now.

claims.label: Host Recalls Tucker Carlson Questioning Donor Wealth at SAS
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA's viewership claim reminds her of what Tucker Carlson said on stage at Student Action Summit when donors got angry as he questioned where the money is coming from and how some people are becoming billionaires.
claims.investigative_direction: Video of Tucker Carlson's Student Action Summit July 2025 remarks and reactions from donors present.
claims.transcript_snippet: It is to me so reminiscent of everything Tucker said when he got onto stage at SAS, when the donors, the Jewish donors got angry, when he questioned exactly where this money is coming from, how these people are becoming billionaires

claims.label: Host Says Alex Clark Tweeted a Triumphant Post Citing 100 Million Views
claims.claim: The host says Alex Clark tweeted that everyone said TPUSA was over and followed it with a '100 million views' figure, which the host calls fiction.
claims.investigative_direction: Alex Clark's X post and its attached figure, with timestamp.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alex Clark shamelessly tweeting everyone said we were over. But look at this.

claims.label: Host Says Bowyer's Tweet Used a Moment From Bad Bunny's Performance
claims.claim: The host says Tyler Bowyer's tweet about TPUSA's concurrent streams used a moment from Bad Bunny's performance showing two men dancing.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive of Bowyer's original post and the attached media.
claims.transcript_snippet: he shows something he probably likes if I'm guessing um this moment of two men dancing on each other and of all people to to tweet this it's Tyler Bowyer

claims.label: Host Says Snow Faced Andrew's and Erika's PR Machine Digging Up His Past
claims.claim: The host says Mitch Snow faced the full brunt of Andrew Kolvet's and Erika Kirk's PR machine, which dug up his past and claimed he was a habitual liar.
claims.investigative_direction: Public statements by TPUSA or Kolvet about Snow's credibility and any coordinated posts.
claims.transcript_snippet: You will recall that Mitch Snow, the man who had to deal with the full brunt of Andrew and Erika's PR machine. Um, they were digging up his past, claiming that he was a habitual liar.

claims.label: Host Says Snow Has Not Changed His Account of Seeing Erika at Fort Huachuca on the 8th
claims.claim: The host says Mitch Snow has not moved his story and remains certain he saw Erika Kirk on the evening of the 8th at Fort Huachuca leaving a hotel with a Cabot Phillips lookalike.
claims.investigative_direction: Hotel and base access records for September 8, 2025 and Snow's original account.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was certain, and I want to be clear, he also hasn't moved his story since, not one inch. He was certain that he saw Erika Kirk on the evening of the 8th at Fort Huachuca leaving a hotel with a Cabot Phillips lookalike.

claims.label: Host Says Snow Walked Into the End of a Briefing for the Joint Task Force Southern Border
claims.claim: The host says Snow claims he stumbled upon what appeared to be the conclusion of a military briefing before a mission, held in a borrowed building site for the Joint Task Force Southern Border unit.
claims.investigative_direction: Fort Huachuca building-use records and JTF Southern Border schedules for September 8-9, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: he claims that he stumbled upon what appeared to him to be the conclusion of a military briefing right before a mission taking place in a borrowed building site for the joint task force, the Southern Border Unit.

claims.label: Host Relays Snow's Exchange With a Man Wearing a JTF Patch
claims.claim: The host relays that Snow saw a man wearing a JTF patch, which she thinks Snow said was JTF 10 and the 10th Mountain Brigade, and was told the unit is now in that building, although Snow thought it had been disbanded.
claims.investigative_direction: Snow's detailed account and the unit's official status and location.
claims.transcript_snippet: He saw a guy wearing the JTF thing. I think he said it was JTF 10, the 10th Mount Mountain Brigade.

claims.label: Host Says the Joint Task Force Was Initially Formed in Tucson
claims.claim: The host says the joint task force was initially formed in Tucson, Arizona.
claims.investigative_direction: Official history of Joint Task Force Six and Joint Task Force Southern Border.
claims.transcript_snippet: And you should know that the that joint task force initially was formed in Tucson, Arizona.

claims.label: Host Says Tracy Martin Has Been Erika's Best Friend for Over 15 Years
claims.claim: The host says Tracy Martin, introduced last week, has been Erika Kirk's best friend for over fifteen years.
claims.investigative_direction: Public photos, posts and statements showing the friendship and its length.
claims.transcript_snippet: Remember, Tracy Martin is Erika's best friend for over 15 years.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Modeled for Tracy's Clothing Brands and Tracy Mentions Romanian Angels
claims.claim: The host says Erika and Tracy have done everything together, that Tracy mentions Romanian Angels, and that Erika modeled for Tracy's clothing brands.
claims.investigative_direction: Tracy Martin's brand pages and Romanian Angels materials showing Erika's involvement.
claims.transcript_snippet: They've done everything together. Tracy says Romanian Angels. Uh Erika modeled for her clothing brands.

claims.label: Host Says Tracy's Husband Thomas Martin Is Involved in Fitness and Ran Gyms
claims.claim: The host says she had trouble learning about Tracy Martin's husband, Thomas Martin, who she says is involved in fitness and the couple ran gyms.
claims.investigative_direction: Business registrations for the Martins' gyms.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's got quite a build. He looks kind of military-esque to me, but they are also involved in fitness. They ran gyms.

claims.label: Host Relays a Tip That a Thomas Martin Is a Border Patrol Director and Southern Command Chief of Staff in Tucson
claims.claim: The host relays a tip, which she cautions may not pan out, that a Thomas Martin is a director of US Border Patrol and chief of staff of the Southern Command in Tucson; she does not assert he is Tracy Martin's husband.
claims.investigative_direction: Federal personnel directories or CBP press releases naming a Thomas Martin in that role; any link to Tracy Martin's husband.
claims.transcript_snippet: There is a director of US Border Patrol, also chief of staff uh of the Southern Command in Tucson named Thomas Martin.

claims.label: Host Says This Thomas Martin Has Wiped His Public Presence
claims.claim: The host says this particular Thomas Martin has gone to great lengths to completely wipe his public presence, noting that his LinkedIn link no longer opens.
claims.investigative_direction: Web archive snapshots of the LinkedIn profile and other listings, with dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: this particular Thomas Martin has gone through great lengths to completely wipe his public presence.

claims.label: Host Says Erika's Mother Has Extensive Contracts With DHS
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk's mother is involved in extensive contracts with the Department of Homeland Security.
claims.investigative_direction: Federal contract databases (USAspending, SAM.gov) for the mother's company.
claims.transcript_snippet: The Department of Homeland Security for which we know Erika Kirk's mother also is involved extensive contracts with the Department of Homeland Security.

claims.label: Host Reads 1985 Article on the Tucson Sanctuary Movement Trial
claims.claim: The host reads from the 1985 Times Union article that Southside Presbyterian Church, two Roman Catholic priests, a nun and six church lay workers were going on trial in Tucson for concealing illegal aliens.
claims.investigative_direction: Full text of the Times Union article of October 21, 1985 and court records of the sanctuary trial.
claims.transcript_snippet: Southside Presbyterian Church, two Roman Catholic priests, a nun, and si six church lay workers were all going on trial in Tucson for concealing illegal aliens.

claims.label: Host Says the Tucson Thomas Martin Is Not Thomas G. Martin of Buffalo
claims.claim: The host says the Tucson Thomas Martin is not Thomas G. Martin, a Border Patrol employee in Buffalo, New York, and that she has already investigated that obvious lead.
claims.investigative_direction: Border Patrol assignment records distinguishing the two men.
claims.transcript_snippet: Martin. That is not the same Thomas Martin that has been in Tucson. We've obviously already investigated the obvious lead there.

claims.label: Host Asks for Tips on the Tucson Thomas Martin
claims.claim: The host asks viewers for tips on the Tucson Thomas Martin, including from anyone who worked with him, via the more-tips address.
claims.investigative_direction: Submitted tips on Thomas Martin's career and colleagues.
claims.transcript_snippet: Please do send us tips to uh tips uh more tips, pardon, canowens. com because we'd like to know maybe somebody worked with this Thomas Martin.

claims.label: Host Says This Thomas Martin Lived in Tucson Until at Least 2011 and Worked With Southern Command
claims.claim: The host says this Thomas Martin has lived in the Tucson area for decades, at least up until 2011, and that she can find a record of him working with the Southern Command.
